verdict.summary: Round 1's major finding is resolved. The carve-out is now restricted to the explicitly audited `.github/feature-matrix.d/` tree rather than attempting an incomplete repository-wide inventory of raw-text YAML consumers. Workflow YAML remains categorically ineligible, including the concrete Miri and fast-fix-ring counterexamples. The implementation fails closed when revisions, blobs, PyYAML, parsing, or document equality are unavailable, and the tests exercise real PyYAML comment behavior, block-scalar changes, selection consequences, and the allowlist boundary. The current consumers named by the audit all parse fragments as YAML (or merely use the directory as a path filter), so parsed-document equality preserves their observed behavior.
